verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single line on ClickUp's site listing "iOS & Android" apps, which shows ClickUp ships mobile apps. Nothing documents what those apps can do or whether they match desktop features. missing for 10: documentation of mobile task-management features, evidence of feature parity with desktop/web, confirmation the apps are native, independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile app quality.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality
